correctness.rationale: The feasible budget simplex is compact; a strictly positive conductance allocation gives a positive spanning-tree polynomial so every optimum has connected support. For a simple graph the reduced weighted Laplacian is an injective linear function of all individual weights, and logdet is strictly concave over connected supports; hence the maximizing vector is unique. The full simultaneous matching-label permutation group and side swap force only two conductance classes. Four Laplacian eigenspaces yield 0, 2d, nb with multiplicity n−1, and 2a+(n−2)b with multiplicity n−1, giving exact tree count. Under a=zb, budget substitution leaves F(z)=(z+n−1)(2z+n−2)^(n−1)/(τz+n−1)^(2n−1), whose logarithmic derivative has a quadratic numerator with unique positive root for τ<τc and is negative on z>0 for τ>=τc. The root and crown effective-resistance ratio match the stated values. A fresh independent symbolic derivative factorization agreed identically, as did exact rational Laplacian determinants for n=3..6 and representative weights. Finite checks corroborate the global strict-concavity proof, not replace it.
residual_risks: No universal conclusion from the randomized feasible allocations; proof uses strict concavity and exact calculus.

originality.rationale: Ge–Dong 2019 supplies exact spanning-tree enumeration for matching-conditioned/deleted complete bipartite graphs, and their results can generate the unoptimized two-class tree polynomial and crown resistance; none of those ingredients is claimed new. Khosoussi et al 2016 provide general weighted tree design/convex-relaxation methods, while Ghosh–Boyd–Saberi optimize total effective resistance, a different criterion. The inspected results do not state the unique unrestricted continuous price-budget optimizer, phase transition τc(n), or exact allocation. The classification follows from known tools with nontrivial symmetry and root analysis, so proximity to known counting formulas is an important priority and mathematical-value risk.
residual_risks: The Ge–Dong generating-polynomial results supply all coefficients, so the remaining strict-concavity and calculus could be a routine implicit consequence in another source.
